date.as_written: vasvaṃka bhūpaiḥ pramite śake abde sarpasya tithyāṃ śanivāsareśudā

notes: The chronogram vasu (8), aṅka (9), bhūpa (16) yields Śaka 1698, which corresponds to VS 1833 as noted in the catalogue record (1776 CE). Sarpasya tithi refers to pañcamī. The scribe explicitly states he copied the text for money (dhanārthe).
